title: The Land-for-Jobs Scam
dek: A railway minister's family is accused of running recruitment as a bargaining tool — trading government jobs for parcels of land transferred to family members, years before the case caught up with them.

heroStat.label: circle-rate value of the land at the centre of the case

promise.quote: Group D recruitment to the Indian Railways under the Union Railway Minister will follow standard, merit-based public recruitment procedure.
promise.madeBy: Ministry of Railways, under then-Minister Lalu Prasad Yadav
promise.role: Union ministry responsible for railway recruitment
promise.context: The CBI alleges that between 2004 and 2009, candidates were given Group D railway jobs in exchange for transferring land, often at below-market rates, to Lalu Prasad Yadav's family members.

target.description: Railway recruitment conducted on merit through standard public examination and selection procedures, with no exchange of land or other benefits for appointment.
target.standard: Standard Railway Recruitment Board procedures and public service merit-selection norms.

reality.description: The CBI filed a chargesheet alleging a criminal conspiracy in which Group D jobs were awarded in exchange for land transfers to the Yadav family. A Delhi court ordered the framing of charges against Lalu Prasad Yadav, his wife and former Bihar Chief Minister Rabri Devi, and other family members including sons Tejashwi Yadav and Tej Pratap Yadav and daughters Misa Bharti and Hema Yadav, on 9 January 2026; charges were formally framed against Yadav and Rabri Devi on 16 February 2026, with both pleading not guilty. The ED has separately attached assets worth roughly ₹6 crore in a related money-laundering case.

gap.metricLabel: Circle-rate value of land allegedly transferred vs. assets attached by the ED
gap.note: Unusually for a case on this site, the ED's attachment exceeds the circle-rate value of the underlying land — likely reflecting the value of downstream assets the agency alleges were built up using the land, not the land transaction alone.

keyIndividuals.outcome: Charges framed February 2026; pleaded not guilty. Trial ongoing.

verdict.summary: Preliminary verdict, pending fuller research: a court has found enough evidence to frame charges and proceed to trial against multiple family members, which is a real step beyond a bare accusation. No verdict has been reached, and the underlying allegations remain to be proven or disproven at trial.
verdict.reasoning: The framing of charges is a judicial determination that a prima facie case exists, documented in contemporaneous legal reporting. Confidence is not higher because the trial itself has only just begun and no evidence has yet been tested in court.
